monopoly-areas.alt: A monopoly graph with Price and cost on the vertical axis and Quantity on the horizontal axis. QM is where MR crosses MC; PM is read up on the demand curve. Consumer surplus (blue), the profit rectangle between PM and ATC (pink) and the deadweight loss triangle between D and MC from QM to QE (orange) are shaded.

monopoly-natural.alt: A natural monopoly graph with Price and cost on the vertical axis and Quantity on the horizontal axis: a falling ATC curve above a flat MC, demand D and MR. Three points are marked: QM and PM where MR = MC, QF and PF where D meets ATC, and QS and PS where D meets MC.
